response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile full-stack/backend engineer with deep expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, D language, and web platforms, but his C++ experience is minimal and outdated (roughly one year, ending in 2015) and C++ isn't even listed in his current skills. He lacks demonstrated experience with IEC 62443, MQTT, message brokers, multi-threaded C++ systems, or industrial automation/IoT protocols central to this role, making him a poor match despite 15+ years of general software experience.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across web, mobile, and backend systems
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and workshop/conference speaking experience
Strong track record with distributed systems, async I/O, and performance-focused development (e.g., DLang low-latency microservices)
concerns: C++ experience is extremely limited (~6 months, ending in 2015) and not a current skill area
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity experience
No demonstrated experience with MQTT, message brokers, or IoT/industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)

key_factors.factor: Strong general software engineering and architecture skills
